description: Two-pass precedent transaction research pipeline for Warp/Oz agents. Discovers M&A deals, filters to qualified multiples, deep-dives, and delivers markdown/PDF/Excel output. Persists deals to SQLite for cross-run querying and sweeps.

ptbot.description: Run a single precedent transaction analysis for one sector/geography/period.

optional_flags.--db-path: SQLite database path for persistence (e.g. ~/.ptbot/ptbot.db). Omit to skip.
optional_flags.--min-multiples: Minimum qualifying standard multiples required per deal (default: 1)
optional_flags.--config-only: Print generated config JSON and exit without running agents

ptbot sweep:auto.description: Auto-populate the deal database by sweeping one or more sectors over annual windows using parallel cloud agents. No TOML config file needed. Existing market×year combinations are skipped automatically.

required_flags.--geography: Geographic scope applied to all sectors

optional_flags.--years: Number of calendar years to look back (default: 5)
optional_flags.--environment: Oz cloud environment ID — enables cloud dispatch and parallel execution. Omit to use local agents.
optional_flags.--max-active: Abort if this many cloud runs are already active in the registry (default: 10). See cloud safeguards.
optional_flags.--dry-run: Print planned runs without invoking any agents

safeguards: WIP cap: aborts before dispatch if active cloud runs >= --max-active
Timeout watchdog: daemon thread kills runs past timeout x 1.5 seconds
Skip detection: existing combinations are never re-run

ptbot-sweep.description: TOML-config-driven sweep runner. Use for version-controlled or scheduled sweeps. Supports the same skip logic and cloud dispatch as sweep:auto.

required_flags.--config: Path to TOML sweep config file (see sweep.example.toml)

optional_flags.--cloud: Dispatch cloud agents instead of local agents
optional_flags.--max-active: WIP cap override (default: from config, fallback 10)
optional_flags.--dry-run: Print planned runs without executing any agents

config_fields.sweep.years_back: Number of annual windows to generate (default: 10)
config_fields.sweep.db_sync_s3_uri: Optional S3 URI for cross-run DB sync (e.g. s3://bucket/ptbot.db)

ptbot query runs.description: List pipeline runs in the database with per-run deal counts.

optional_flags.--limit: Maximum number of runs to show (default: 20)
optional_flags.--since: Only show runs on or after DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)

ptbot query deals.description: Search deals across all pipeline runs with optional filters.

optional_flags.--since: Only show deals on or after DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
optional_flags.--qualified-only: Only show qualified deals (have disclosed standard multiples)
optional_flags.--limit: Maximum number of deals to show (default: 50)

ptbot query export.description: Export deals to CSV or JSON for downstream use.

optional_flags.--limit: Maximum number of deals to export (default: all)

ptbot cloud status.description: List cloud agent dispatches in the registry.

optional_flags.--all: Include terminal (completed/revoked) runs. Default: active only.

ptbot cloud kill.description: Revoke/kill a specific cloud Oz run by its run ID or URL prefix.

required_flags.run_id: The oz run_id from a prior cloud dispatch (or run_url prefix)

optional_flags.--force: Mark revoked in registry even if oz CLI kill command fails

ptbot cloud kill-all.description: Nuclear firedrill recovery: kills every active cloud run in the registry in one command. Marks all runs revoked in the DB even when the oz CLI fails.

optional_flags.--dry-run: Print what would be killed without taking action

ptbot app.description: Launch the Streamlit deal database dashboard. Provides interactive deal browser, run history, and Cloud Control page for managing active cloud dispatches.

tables.runs: One row per pipeline run with params JSON and timestamp
tables.deals: One row per deal candidate with qualification status and multiples
tables.cloud_runs: One row per cloud agent dispatch with status, run_url, and revocation tracking

database.s3_sync: Set sweep.db_sync_s3_uri in TOML config to pull before and push after each sweep run

cloud_safeguards.kill_all: ptbot cloud kill-all [--dry-run] — kills every active run; marks revoked even when oz CLI fails
cloud_safeguards.wip_cap: --max-active N (default: 10) — aborts before dispatch if active cloud runs >= N. Message includes blocking run IDs.
cloud_safeguards.timeout_watchdog: Daemon thread launched automatically during cloud sweeps. Polls every 60s; kills runs past timeout x 1.5 seconds. Stops on sweep completion or Ctrl-C.

agent_integration.description: Agent-facing facade exposing search_deals, export_deals_to_excel, query_and_export_excel, and get_database_summary. Import directly in Oz agent scripts.

key_functions.get_database_summary(): Returns total runs, deals, qualified deals, sectors covered, and years in the DB
key_functions.search_deals(sector, geography, qualifie: Returns raw deal rows matching filters
key_functions.export_deals_to_excel(deals_or_rows, out: Writes deals to Excel. style='light' for simple single-sheet; style='full' for IB-formatted workbook.
key_functions.query_and_export_excel(sector, geography: One-shot: search + export in a single call
